summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) disclosing the registration of a public capital-reduction deed with the Commercial Registry of Santander on November 11, 2026. The reduction is EUR 75,297,550 via cancellation of 150,595,100 treasury shares (~1.03% of capital), set at the executive committee meeting of November 4, 2026, following an October 28 notice. Post-reduction capital is EUR 7,202,943,850.50 across 14,405,887,701 shares of EUR 0.50 nominal. Cumulative buybacks since 2021 total 3,264,600,039 shares (~18.8%), reducing capital by EUR 1,632,300,019.50. Watch continued buyback cadence and CET1 accretion.
